eventDetail.eventTitle: 2026 7th IEICE-CS International Conference on Emerging Technologies for Communications (ICETCCOM)
eventDetail.about: Communication, Networking and Broadcast Technologies; Computing and Processing; Photonics and Electrooptics
eventDetail.scope: As the flagship conference of the IEICE Communications Society, ICETC has continuously provided a vital platform for exchanging ideas and fostering collaboration since its inception in 2020. With a strong tradition of promoting cutting-edge research, ICETC 2026 will explore key technological advancements that will shape the future of global connectivity. The world is rapidly approaching a new era where telecommunication technologies will serve as the foundation of society, much like a lifeline that supports our daily lives and industries. As we step into the 2030s, we are witnessing a paradigm shift driven by, but not limited to, AI integration, AI Cloud and Edge Computing, Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN), All-Photonics Networks (APN), and next-generation Radio Access Networks (RAN), etc. These transformative technologies will redefine communication infrastructure, enabling intelligent, resilient, and ultra-efficient networks.
